title: Kenyan Chicken Fajitas
description: Spicy fajitas with a Kenyan twist, featuring smoky chicken and crispy flatbread.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the chicken with Kenyan spices, smoky paprika, salt, and black pepper.
3. Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, grill the peppers and onion for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender.
5. Warm the flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
6. Slice the grilled chicken and serve with peppers, onion, and flatbread.
7. Serve with your favorite toppings, such as sour cream, salsa, or avocado.
